title: Naturality in both inputs of the tensor adjoint comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite coefficient field E over Q_l, a scheme X and a normalized IntegralHom.TensorPresentation a over its completed coefficient sheaf [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-models]. Let S=scalarIntegralClosed l E X [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension]. For each K let gamma_K be Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq from a.adjunction K to S.adjunction K. For any pairs P,Q and morphism f=(f1,f2):P to Q, a.tensor.map(f) followed by gamma_Q1 at Q2 equals gamma_P1 at P2 followed by S.tensor.map(f2,f1). These components define a natural tensor isomorphism from a.tensor to the canonical tensor with the two inputs swapped. No coefficient extension is involved.

proof.text: Use the counit identity of IntegralHom.evaluation_naturality and the evaluation_naturality field of the canonical CoefficientClosedStructure. Expanding inverse transposition as the tensor map followed by its counit and using naturality of the tensor map proves parameter naturality for each adjunction. Apply the Hom equivalence to obtain the corresponding forward-transposition identity.

The unique comparison of left adjoints intertwines their Hom equivalences. Apply the first adjunction Hom equivalence to the first-variable comparison square. Both sides become the same parameter-transposition formula, proving equality by injectivity. Naturality of leftAdjointUniq gives the second-variable square. Factor a product morphism into its two variable maps and paste. NatIso.ofComponents now constructs tensorAdjointComparison with the prescribed components and no choice of data.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorAdjointComparison_naturality
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (a : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (P Q : IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X × IntegralVerdier.Ambient l E X)
    (f : P ⟶ Q) :
    a.tensor.map f ≫
        (Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq (a.adjunction Q.1)
          ((scalarIntegralClosed l E X).adjunction Q.1)).hom.app Q.2 =
      (Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq (a.adjunction P.1)
          ((scalarIntegralClosed l E X).adjunction P.1)).hom.app P.2 ≫
        (scalarIntegralClosed l E X).tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f.2 f.1)
